newsitem.title: USA: Innovo says preliminary FY96 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Innovo says preliminary FY96 sales rise.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc Tuesday said that the preliminary sales figures for the fiscal year ended November 30, 1996 year were $7.4 million, compared with $5.3 million in fiscal 1995.
Innovo's December 1996 sales were $917,000 compared with $233,000 for the same period in 1995, a rise of 294 percent.
For the fourth quarter of the fiscal year sales were $1,721,000 versus $1,274,000 for the year-ago period.
Company officials said Innovo Group currently expected to release complete fiscal 1996 results at the end of February.

The company said that the December sales rise was led by the initial shipment to Wal-Mart Stores Inc of craft products for a new, planned shelf-space program that Wal-Mart expects to run throughout 1997, and a resurgence in demand for Innovo's pro licensed products.
